rationale: host_runner.py has zero subprocess execution anywhere today; every build_blocking_json caller executes the subprocess itself per the HostInvocation docstring contract. Option A preserves this convention and leaves all 16 existing evaluators.subprocess.run test patches untouched. Option B would introduce the first subprocess execution point inside host_runner.py, duplicating parsing logic with no precedent.
alternatives_rejected: Option B: host_runner.py owns subprocess.run internally, requiring re-targeting 16 test patch sites
